scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to the Children who are Recipients of National Child Award for Exceptional Achievements and Other National / International Merit Awards
description:
The "Award of Scholarship to the Children who are Recipients of National Child Award for Exceptional Achievements and Other National / International Merit Awards" is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India.

This scheme was launched in the year 2009.

The primary objective of this scholarship program is to provide financial assistance to children who have shown exceptional achievements in various fields.

The scheme aims to encourage and support these children in their educational pursuits.

The scholarship is awarded to children who have received the National Child Award for Exceptional Achievement.

Additionally, it is also available for children who have received other national or international merit awards.

The scholarship amount is set at INR 20,000 per annum.

This financial assistance is intended to help cover educational expenses.

Eligible candidates must be between the ages of 5 and 18 years.

The scholarship is specifically targeted at children who have demonstrated outstanding achievements.

These achievements can be in fields such as sports, arts, culture, and academics.

The application process for this scholarship involves several steps.

Interested candidates must first obtain the application form from the official website of the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

The application form must be filled out completely and accurately.

Applicants are required to submit proof of their achievements.

This proof can include certificates or awards received.

In addition to the application form and proof of achievement, applicants must also provide a copy of their birth certificate.

A copy of the school admission or attendance certificate is also required.

The completed application form and all supporting documents must be submitted to the respective State Government or Union Territory administration.

The deadline for submitting applications typically falls within the month of August each year.

Once the applications are received, they are reviewed by the respective authorities.

The selection process is based on the merit of the achievements presented.

Successful applicants will receive the scholarship amount directly into their bank accounts.

The scholarship is disbursed annually.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

This ministry is responsible for the overall management and execution of the scheme.

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

The contact details for the ministry can be found on their official website.

The scheme not only provides financial support but also aims to recognize and honor the achievements of children.

It serves as a motivation for other children to strive for excellence in their respective fields.

The scholarship is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to promote education and development among children.

The National Child Award for Exceptional Achievement was first instituted in 1996.

This award recognizes children for their exceptional achievements in various fields.

The scholarship serves as a continuation of this recognition.

The scheme is also aligned with the government's commitment to the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child.

This convention emphasizes the importance of education and development for children.

The scholarship amount of INR 20,000 is intended to alleviate some of the financial burdens associated with education.

This amount can be used for tuition fees, books, and other educational materials.

The scheme is particularly beneficial for children from economically weaker sections of society.

It aims to ensure that financial constraints do not hinder a child's educational journey.

The scholarship is renewable every year, provided the student continues to meet the eligibility criteria.

This includes maintaining a satisfactory academic record.

The scheme has seen various children from diverse backgrounds benefit from its provisions.

It has played a significant role in promoting talent and excellence among the youth of India.

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach.

The scholarship is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at children in India.

These schemes focus on various aspects of child development including health, education, and protection.

The government encourages parents and guardians to apply for this scholarship on behalf of eligible children.

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme.

The scholarship is a testament to the government's recognition of the importance of nurturing young talent.

It reflects a commitment to fostering an environment where children can thrive and achieve their potential.

The scheme is also a part of the government's efforts to promote inclusivity in education.

It aims to ensure that all children, regardless of their background, have access to quality education.

The scholarship is a valuable resource for children who have already demonstrated exceptional capabilities.

It provides them with the necessary support to further their education and achieve greater heights.

The impact of this scholarship can be seen in the success stories of past recipients.

Many have gone on to excel in their respective fields, contributing positively to society.

The government continues to encourage applications from deserving candidates.

The scholarship not only provides financial assistance but also recognition of hard work and dedication.

This recognition can significantly boost a child's confidence and motivation.

The scheme is a vital part of India's commitment to empowering its youth.

It underscores the belief that every child deserves the opportunity to succeed.

The scholarship is a step towards ensuring that exceptional talent is nurtured and rewarded.

The government remains dedicated to supporting children who strive for excellence.

This initiative is crucial in building a brighter future for the nation through its youth.
